text:
Good evening, Burlington. It's a mild one out there, in the 60s with a light southwest breeze, and sunset comes at 4:40 under a mostly clear sky. Clouds build in after dark, but it won't be a chilly night, with a low around 52. You can leave the heavy coat inside.

Tomorrow turns grayer and a little cooler, with a high near 60. Showers are possible, and the best window looks like early to mid afternoon, roughly 1 to 5. NWS keeps amounts under a tenth of an inch, but the European model and one other are wetter than the rest, so I'd lean toward the showers showing up. Nothing soaking, but carry the umbrella. Mornings should stay dry for the commute.

The payoff comes Wednesday, the warmest day of the week, with low to mid 70s and a few records possible. Enjoy it, because steady rain moves in Thursday.
